title: A Light Left On
body:
# A Light Left On

This fictional reflection accompanies the promise planet. The journey is measured in what the traveler notices, as much as in distance.

## A small observation

A faint tone returns each evening. At first it seems like interference. After a while, it becomes familiar.

> Attention can turn an ordinary moment into a landmark.

## Carry it forward

1. Remember the sound.
2. Describe it in your own words.
3. Notice what changes the next time you hear it.
